title: Changing tts_backend on an existing job serves stale audio from the old backend
description:
`cdk/lambdas/router/handler.py` around line 263, inside `_create_job`'s
`ConditionalCheckFailedException` branch:

```python
if existing.get("tts_backend") != tts_backend:
    print(f"UPDATING {content_hash} from ... to {tts_backend}", flush=True)
    _jobs.update_item(
        Key={"content_hash": content_hash},
        UpdateExpression="SET tts_backend = :backend",
        ExpressionAttributeValues={":backend": tts_backend},
    )
    existing["tts_backend"] = tts_backend
return _response(200, {"content_hash": ..., "status": existing.get("status"), "existing": True})
```

The record's `tts_backend` is rewritten, but `status` stays `done` and
`audio_key` still points at the audio the *previous* backend generated. The
job now claims to be Higgs while serving Kokoro audio, and because status is
still `done` nothing will ever regenerate it. The console and
`GET /admin/jobs` both report the new backend, so the telemetry lies too.

This is also unreachable in normal operation: `_content_hash` mixes
`tts_backend` into the hash, so a different backend produces a different hash
and a different record. The branch only fires when a caller supplies an
explicit `body["content_hash"]` that collides with a row created under another
backend -- which makes it a silent corruption path guarded by nothing.

## Fix

Delete the branch. When a caller passes an explicit `content_hash` whose
stored `tts_backend` differs from the request, that is a conflict, not an
in-place mutation: return the existing job unchanged, or reject it. Changing a
job's backend is what the regenerate story in this epic is for, and that path
resets status and drops the stale audio correctly.

Remove the bare `print` with it; it is debug output on a production path.

## Regression

```gherkin
Feature: Job backend integrity on content hash collision

  Scenario: A job keeps its backend and audio when a colliding hash arrives
    Given a job exists with backend "kokoro", status "done", and stored audio
    When a job is created with that explicit content hash and backend "higgs"
    Then the stored job still has backend "kokoro"
    And the stored job still points at the original audio
```

Per AGENTS.md, this regression goes in `features/`, not pytest.
